title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Wir sind ganz vorne mit dabei, wenn es darum geht KI-Systeme der Zukunft zu gestalten. Unsere Mission: Mit smarter, evolutionärer KI und echtem Praxisnutzen die Beratung und den Verkauf auf ein neues Level heben. Du bist unser Architekt und Treiber für planbares, skalierbares Neukundengeschäft – und die Person, die aus Marketingbudget verlässlich Pipeline und Umsatz macht. Datenbasiert, effizient und mit klarem Blick auf die Wachstumsziele des Unternehmens. Dabei leistest du echte Pionierarbeit: Als unser erster Performance Marketing Manager baust du diesen Bereich von Grund auf – als Stratege und Umsetzer in einer Person. Es geht nicht um Teamführung, sondern darum, mit eigenen Händen ein starkes Fundament zu legen. Ein Teamaufbau ist für später geplant, und du gestaltest ihn mit. Du verantwortest die Paid-Strategie entlang des gesamten Funnels – von Awareness über Consideration bis hin zur Conversion – und übersetzt Umsatz- und Pipeline-Ziele in konkrete Budgets, Kanalstrategien und Forecasts. Performance-Marketing verstehst du dabei nicht als isolierte Disziplin, sondern als integralen Bestandteil unserer Revenue-Strategie in enger Verzahnung mit Sales und Customer Success. Du setzt die Prioritäten: Du identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale, verantwortest die Test-Roadmap, erschließt neue Kanäle und Märkte und baust Kampagnenstrukturen, die auch bei deutlich steigenden Budgets effizient skalieren. KPIs wie CPL, CAC, Payback, Conversion Rate und Pipeline-Impact sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen, sondern die Grundlage für Steuerung und Planung. Gleichzeitig bringst du strategische Weitsicht und Kommunikationsstärke mit: Du etablierst ein belastbares Tracking- und Attributions-Setup, machst Performance für alle Beteiligten transparent und nutzt moderne KI-Tools sowie Automatisierungen, um Effizienz und Performance stetig zu steigern. Im Mittelpunkt steht: qualitative Leads, transparente Performance-Strukturen und nachhaltiges Wachstum für ein ambitioniertes KI-Startup. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung Marketing & Sales. B. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Talent Acquisition team at Celonis is a global function at the heart of our growth. We go beyond recruiting to act as trusted talent advisors and candidate experience champions, driving strategies that bring future leaders into the business.

We are now looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner with a background hiring technical customer facing roles for a technology company.  This position offers the chance to directly influence our success, in a fast-scaling, international environment.


The Role:

As a trusted partner to our Customer organizations, you will be responsible for overseeing and guiding both hiring managers and candidates through the full life-cycle recruitment process.You will be a strategic advisor to our leaders, bringing not only recruiting expertise but also actionable talent insights that influence hiring decisions and shape our overall talent strategy.

You will act as the trusted partner to our hiring leaders and the main point of contact for our candidates throughout the recruitment journey. Leveraging your background in hiring top technical talent you will bring credibility and market expertise to every search.

Celonis is the market leader in Process Intelligence, and our TA team embraces this innovation daily. With our technology embedded in our ATS, you’ll have access to real-time data and advanced reporting tools that sharpen your ability to advise, plan, and execute.

The work you’ll do:

Stakeholder Collaboration:

  • Partner with our regional hiring managers to understand their hiring needs and job requirements, offering strategic advice and support throughout the recruitment process.
  • Work closely with the HR team and Compensation & Benefits team and other internal stakeholders to align recruitment efforts with company goals and processes.

Full-Cycle Recruitment:

  • Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and extending offers to candidates for Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, Services, PreSales and Value Engineering roles.
  • Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent, utilizing various channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and referrals.

Candidate Experience:

  • Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process by providing timely feedback and communication.
  • Work hand in hand with Talent Coordination to schedule interviews, providing necessary support and resources to both candidates and hiring managers.

Market Research & Talent Insights:

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions to effectively position Celonis as an employer of choice.
  • Provide market intelligence and insights to hiring managers to aid in decision-making and strategy development.

Recruitment Process Excellence: 

  • Track and analyze recruitment metrics to measure the effectiveness of recruiting strategies and processes
  • Provide regular updates and reports to management on recruitment activities, challenges, and successes.
  • Leverage our ATS and Sourcing Tools to ensure excellence and efficiencies are adopted in our working practices

The qualifications you need:

  • A background recruiting technical customer facing roles, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for finding and hiring the best talent.
  • Strong understanding of technology and industry trends.
  • End to end recruitment experience from Sourcing to Offer Management
  • Inhouse, agency or RPO recruitment experience hiring for Product , Technology or IT Services businesses.
  • Proficiency in applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools.
  • Excellent communication skills and interest in interacting with colleagues, candidates and partners.
  • You can come as you are – the fun-loving, passionate seller, who never gets shy of pushing boundaries or asking the tough questions with stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize workload.
  • Strong sourcing and candidate outreach capabilities

 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience: You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. 
  • Technical depth: You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. 
  • Mindset: You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. 
  • Collaboration & communication: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. 
  • Nice to have: It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. 

What you’ll get 

  • A team that values ownership, quality, and speed 
  • Close collaboration between product and engineering 
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours 
  • Unlimited vacation 
  • Competitive compensation 
  • A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact 

Equal Opportunity 

We believe in hiring different and diverse talent and providing a safe space where everyone can share their views without fear, where differences are celebrated, and where no one is left out. Inclusive cultures are the foundation for collaboration and innovation within our team. 

Privacy Notice

By applying for this position, you confirm that you have read and understood Affinidi’s Candidate Privacy Policy, and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment purposes, as described in the policy.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Instrumentation SDK (iOS) | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Mobile Observability initiative gives mobile developers first-class instrumentation SDKs that capture traces, metrics, logs, crashes, and user sessions. Our solutions aim to be tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We’re building high-performance, low-overhead SDKs that make it easy for teams to connect mobile signals to backend and infra telemetry for true full-stack visibility.

We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build and evolve mobile instrumentation SDKs for iOS (Swift / Obj-C), prioritizing performance, stability, and a great developer experience.
  • Design and ship SDK features such as session tracking, crash reporting, sampling strategies, automatic context propagation, and OpenTelemetry integrations.
  • Own projects end-to-end.
  • Break large, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables: design modular solutions, ship MVPs, gather feedback, iterate quickly.
  • Ensure quality: automated tests, CI, documentation, and smooth, backwards-compatible upgrade paths.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to ensure cohesive end-to-end observability workflows.
  • Engage with the open-source community: review PRs, discuss design proposals, and help guide external contributors.
  • Mentor teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the mobile observability roadmap.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You’re a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action and the ability to run with poorly defined scopes. You can operate autonomously while being highly collaborative.
  • Strong mobile engineering experience: with iOS (Swift/Obj-C) and, optionally, Android (Kotlin/Java).
  • Demonstrated experience building or maintaining mobile SDKs, platform libraries, or other developer-facing platform code used by external developers.
  • Experience working with performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, network efficiency) and making pragmatic tradeoffs.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, SDKs, collectors) or experience contributing to/maintaining OTel SDKs or similar telemetry libraries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed team.
  • Coachable, customer-focused, and passionate about developer experience, you can do more than code: you write docs, mentor others, and shape roadmaps.
  • Pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity: you prioritize progress over perfection and iterate quickly based on feedback.

Bonus Points For:

  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries, or other observability OSS.

raw.description:

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, lernst unsere Systeme von Grund auf kennen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsprojekte.

Was macht die asensu GmbH?

Die asensu GmbH ist eine spezialisierte Marketingagentur, die mittelständische Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, online sichtbarer zu werden und planbar neue Kunden sowie qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zu gewinnen. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen aus dem Küchen- und Möbelhandel sowie dem Handwerk.

Neben Werbekampagnen sorgen wir durch Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung dafür, dass unsere Kunden höhere Margen erzielen. Rund 100 Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland vertrauen dabei auf uns. Weil wir weiter wachsen, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Business-Development-Team.

Was sind Deine Aufgaben als Junior Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in (m/w/d)?

Zu Beginn unterstützt du bei laufenden Projekten: Du nimmst Abläufe auf, dokumentierst sie, testest Automatisierungen und pflegst Datenstrukturen. Dabei lernst du, wie unsere Systeme zusammenspielen – vom CRM über die Buchhaltung bis zu unseren Kommunikationskanälen.

Mit wachsender Erfahrung baust du eigene Workflows und Integrationen auf, übernimmst kleinere Projekte eigenverantwortlich und entwickelst dich so zum Spezialisten für Prozessautomatisierung.

  • Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer Tools und IT-Systeme

title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors. Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions. Actively contributing to internal discussions. Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables. As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication. We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems. As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors. Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus. Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus. Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers. A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact. Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents. Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus. Willingness to travel outside Europe. Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform. Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home. Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe. One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.). raw.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.

title: Analytics Engineering Manager
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Our Analytics organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace. We're looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week on-site. In this role, you'll lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a key business domain, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power day-to-day decisions and building the data foundations your stakeholders rely on. About the Analytics Engineering Org Analytics Engineering is a core pillar of Deliveroo's Analytics organisation, alongside Data Science. With over 70 Analytics Engineers across the UK and India, we are embedded directly within product and business domains, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power decision-making at scale: from self-serve AI-enabled analytics and experimentation through to executive reporting and strategic planning. The discipline is evolving fast. With new tooling changing how we work, we are shifting from building data pipelines to building AI first data products, developing rich semantic and data context layers and empowering self-serve data users. This role leads that work across a defined business domain, directly managing a team of Analytics Engineers and helping shape AE standards, culture and direction across the wider org. What You'll Be Doing Directly lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a defined business domain, owning their performance, development and wellbeing Own the AE roadmap for your domain, identifying the highest-leverage investments, prioritising competing requests, and building the case for them with your business and product stakeholders Drive a data products mindset across your estate: clear ownership, SLAs, observability and data contracts built into how your team works by default Maintain strong technical involvement: reviewing data models and SQL, guiding architectural decisions, and stepping in hands-on when your team needs unblocking Contribute to AE-wide decisions on tooling, standards and process, helping shape how Analytics Engineering works at Deliveroo beyond your immediate team Build a high-performing, inclusive team culture by giving regular and actionable feedback, handling performance and motivation challenges, and running effective rituals Partner with Recruiting to hire strong, diverse AE talent into your team What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Experience in an Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, or Data Engineering role, with strong, hands-on SQL foundations you still draw on regularly Proven experience managing a team of ICs, with a track record of developing people, giving hard feedback, and handling typical team situations independently Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap for a domain area and deliver against it with measurable business impact Strong grounding across the modern AE stack (cloud data warehousing, transformation tooling, data modelling, and data quality practices), with the ability to engage credibly on technical decisions and unblock your team Comfortable engaging and influencing at senior business and product level, with experience aligning analytics investment to domain priorities Nice to Have Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, grocery or retail analytics context Familiarity with semantic and metrics layer tooling, or Python for data automation and pipeline work Exposure to AI for Data, including agentic AI methods, semantic layers, or AI-assisted analytics workflows Experience contributing to analytics ways of working: documentation standards, peer review processes, onboarding, and knowledge sharing Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. ​​ 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! JEWLIF – Jüdisches Leben in Europa e. V. mit Sitz in Köln stärkt jüdisches Leben in Deutschland und Europa durch Projekte in Bildung, Wissenschaft, Kunst, Kultur und Medienkompetenz. Für Oktober bis Dezember 2026 suchen wir eine erfahrene selbstständige Fachkraft für Presse, PR und Kommunikation für projektbezogene Aufträge.

Aufgaben

Je nach Anlass vereinbaren wir mit dir einzelne Leistungspakete:

· Pressemitteilungen: Recherche, Texterstellung und Überarbeitung nach Briefing, mit Zitat des Generalsekretärs, Boilerplate und Förderhinweis sowie bis zu zwei Korrekturrunden, einschließlich einer Fassung für unsere Website. Bei Bedarf ergänzt um die Ansprache ausgewählter Redaktionen und einen kurzen Resonanzbericht.

· Pressemappen: Aufbereitung von Informationen zu JEWLIF und einzelnen Maßnahmen mit Factsheets, Hintergrundtexten, FAQ und Bildmaterial. mit geklärten Bildrechten.

· Social Media: Entwicklung von Redaktionsplänen sowie Text und Gestaltung einer vereinbarten Anzahl von Beiträgen, bei Bedarf einschließlich Veröffentlichung.

· Presseanfragen und Veranstaltungen: Recherche und Antwortentwürfe zu einzelnen Anfragen mit Dokumentation in einem Anfrageprotokoll sowie Vorbereitung konkreter Pressetermine mit Einladung, Ablauf, Sprechzettel und Hintergrundinformationen.

· Dokumentation: Erstellung kurzer Checklisten für Presseabläufe (Pressemitteilung, Pressetermin, Presseanfrage und Erstreaktion bei kritischer Berichterstattung) und geordnete Übergabe der erarbeiteten Materialien mit einem abschließenden Übergabegespräch.

Die Zusammenarbeit:

Umfang, Ergebnisse, Termine und Honorar stimmen wir für jedes Leistungspaket vorab miteinander ab. Du setzt die vereinbarten Leistungen eigenverantwortlich mit eigener Ausstattung um und gestaltest Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit selbst. Für Briefings, Rückfragen und Freigaben steht dir eine feste Ansprechperson zur Verfügung. Alles, was nach außen geht, gibt der Generalsekretär frei. Unser CI-Handbuch, unsere Vorlagen und Boilerplates stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

Der voraussichtliche Gesamtumfang liegt bei bis zu 36 Leistungstagen im genannten Zeitraum. Die Beauftragung erfolgt nach Bedarf und gemeinsamer Vereinbarung. Abgerechnet wird monatlich nach Tagesnachweis mit Zuordnung zu den Leistungspaketen.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members across UK and India
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Financial Reporting & Control team is responsible for the preparation of Tide’s key financial reports, as well as implementing and monitoring controls to safeguard the Group’s financial integrity.  The team plays a critical role in ensuring the financial data is accurate and complete, compliant with regulations and presented clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

As our Senior Financial Controller you’ll report to the Lead Financial Controller and be responsible for our credit products and areas of credit risk at Tide.  It’s exciting times here at Tide, we are scaling and developing our product offering at a phenomenal rate!

As Senior Financial Controller you will

  • Controllership of our proprietary credit offerings over our 3 Tide Capital companies with varying credit products. 
  • Ownership of the month end processes for reporting P&L, balance sheet and cashflow
  • Documenting and reviewing loss provisioning policies for credit risk, fraud and disputes, negative balances and other risk costs.  Ongoing monitoring and reporting of credit risk performance and adequacy of provisioning coefficients and methods.
  • Ensuring strong control of the new APPF fraud legislation, including accurate representation of losses from fraudulent transactions in the P&L and ensuring monthly balance sheet substantiation
  • Ensuring strong control over our members accounts with negative (overdrawn) account balances, accurately reporting our P&L each month and ensuring monthly balance sheet substantiation
  • Working closely with the Tide Credit Services business, product and operations teams to understand the performance of our products and ensure that our transactions are correctly recorded
  • Handling the introduction of new credit lending products along with our new investment product.
  • Working closely with the collections team for overdue loan payments, analyzing performance of recovery efforts.
  • Collaborating with the ongoing monitoring, operations and risk teams to monitor and report cost of risk, resulting from the credit portfolio, negative customer account balances, fraud and disputes, chargebacks, etc.
  • Working closely with the FP&A team to support with analysis, budgeting and forecasting of the credit portfolio and cost of risk.
  • Represent the finance team at the Credit Risk Working Group and Risk and Compliance Committee.
  • Building robust financial control processes and strengthening internal controls.
  • Maintain strong balance sheet controls with monthly substantiation.
  • Maintaining relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and accounting advisors.
  • Collating financial data for the preparation of corporation tax ensuring compliance with tax legislation.
  • Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve accounting processes, operations and systems.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in financial services – preferably in technology-driven & scale-up environments
  • Experience with credit products and provisioning for credit risk essential
  • Strong financial acumen and excellent technical accounting skills. Familiar with accounting standard and disclosure requirements under UK GAAP and/or IFRS
  • Dealt with the statutory audit of financial services company
  • Hold a professional finance qualification
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Thrive work with minimal hands-on management
  • Meticulous attention to detail
  • Comfort in taking responsibility for business-critical financial operations
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Motivated by Tide’s values and mission 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

  • Competitive Compensation -  competitive salary 
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. For this role we would expect the role holder to attend our Old Street offices at least one day a week.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 
Disclaimer
 
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Account Executive - Liverpool
description:
Account Executive (Liverpool)

Remote (with Travel around North West UK Territory)

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As an Account Executive in the Liverpool Region, you will drive the expansion of our dining network by acquiring new restaurant partners through a consultative sales approach. You will act as a trusted advisor to top restaurants, demonstrating how our industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology can optimize their revenue potential. In this remote position with up to 60% domestic travel, you will play a crucial role in empowering restaurants to focus on their teams and guests. Your strategic efforts will directly influence our market presence and the continued success of the hospitality industry in your territory.

Responsibilities 

  • Identify, target, and approach prospective restaurant customers within your assigned territory to drive revenue and consistently exceed acquisition targets.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with elite restaurant partners, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge their business perspectives and offer industry insights.
  • Deliver high-quality, customized, data-driven demonstrations of our solutions in person and online to address specific partner needs.
  • Develop comprehensive business plans to define selling strategies, overcome competitive objections, and drive long-term business value.
  • Utilise Salesforce effectively to manage your territory, forecast sales activity, process contracts, and stay organized.
  • Gather and present valuable customer feedback to product and marketing teams while maintaining visibility in the hospitality industry through networking.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in business-to-business (B2B) enterprise sales.
  • Drive with a full UK driving license and access to a car
  • Proven track record of goal-oriented sales performance, including outbound lead generation and pipeline management.
  • Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with up to 60% domestic travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior sales experience within the food and beverage industry.
  • Strong ability to leverage data and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and build compelling business cases.
  • Exceptional time management, discovery, and negotiation skills.
  • A highly collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and
    hospitality technology.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

 

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

 

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Supply Chain Technician – Coventry, UK (Fixed-Term, Minimum 30 Hours/Week)
description:
Type: Fixed-term contract (6 months), 30 hours per week
Work Location: Coventry
Pay:  £17 per hour
Licence/Certification: Full valid UK driving licence (required)

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimise brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.

We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.

 

Job Description

We are currently expanding our operations throughout the UK and seeking a dedicated Supply Chain Technician to support our warehouse and logistics operations. This role will primarily involve working standard warehouse hours (days) but may include occasional weekend or evening shifts depending on business needs. As a crucial member of our team, you will be responsible for keeping our camera hardware inventory accurate, picking orders, and repairing equipment ready to return to the field. Physical stamina, attention to detail, and technical aptitude are essential for this role.

This will be a 6 Month contract position, working a minimum 30 hrs per week with a possibility to extend beyond the initial contract.

  • Possibility of weekend or night work
  • Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's license and reliable transportation is required.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Pick orders and prepare pallets for deliveries, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Complete accurate inventory counts and maintain up-to-date stock records
  • Repair cameras and hardware components so they can be returned to the field in good working order
  • Diagnose faults in returned camera hardware and determine repair or replacement needs
  • Onboard/scan products into the system as required
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed, parts used, and time spent, using company-provided tools
  • Operate warehouse equipment (e.g. pallet trucks, hand tools) safely and efficiently
  • Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to minimise risks during warehouse operations
  • Work collaboratively with team members to ensure timely completion of orders and repairs
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail to ensure inventory and repair work meets quality standards
  • Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members to provide updates on progress and flag any issues or challenges
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures at all times

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in a warehouse, supply chain, inventory, or technical repair role
  • Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware issues efficiently
  • Experience with pallet preparation, order picking, and inventory management processes
  • Physical Stamina: Strong physical stamina to work on feet and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods (up to 9 hours)
  • Detail-Oriented: Excellent attention to detail to ensure inventory counts and repair work meet quality standards
  • Time Management: Ability to work well under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills to liaise with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and addressing any issues
  • Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's licence preferred
  • Ability to work occasional weekends or evenings as needed
  • Ability to work nights and weekends

Why Focal Systems

Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.

Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.

Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.

What we offer
We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:    

  • Paid Time Off
  • Pension
  • Sick Leave

title: Senior National Account Manager (Convenience) - Myprotein
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Manchester, THG ICON 1, WA15 0AF (Hybrid) 

About THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands, Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries; to power and empower those who want more. 

Why be a Senior National Account Manager at Myprotein?

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior National Account Manager to lead and grow Myprotein’s presence within the UK Convenience channel. This role will be responsible for developing strategic partnerships with key convenience retailers and wholesale groups, delivering sustainable sales growth, and expanding distribution across a fast-growing category.

The successful candidate will have strong FMCG or consumer health experience, a proven track record managing national retail accounts, and the ability to build long-term customer relationships in a highly competitive market.

As a Senior National Account Manager (Convenience) you will:
  • Own and manage key Convenience channel accounts including symbol groups, wholesalers, travel retail, and impulse-focused retailers.
  • Deliver annual sales, profit, and distribution targets across the channel.
  • Develop and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) aligned to wider commercial objectives.
  • Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, promotional plans, new listings, and range reviews.
  • Identify growth opportunities within protein, wellness, functional nutrition, and snacking categories.
  • Work closely with category, marketing, supply chain, and demand planning teams to optimise account performance.
  • Analyse sales data, market trends, and customer insights to drive commercial decision-making.
  • Manage forecasting and promotional planning to maximise availability and minimise risk.
  • Build strong relationships with buyers, category managers, and key decision-makers across the convenience landscape.
  • Support the expansion of Myprotein’s retail footprint within emerging convenience and impulse channels.
What skills and experience do I need for this role?
  • Proven experience in National Account Management within FMCG, sports nutrition, beverages, health & wellness, or snacking categories.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Convenience retail landscape.
  • Experience managing major convenience, wholesale, or impulse retail accounts.
  • Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth and commercial targets.
  • Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong analytical and forecasting capability.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commercially minded with an entrepreneurial approach to growth opportunities.

Desirable Experience

  • Existing relationships with UK convenience retailers and wholesalers.
  • Experience within challenger brands or high-growth businesses.
  • Knowledge of sports nutrition, functional health, or performance products.
  • Experience working with Booker, Co-op, Spar, WHSmith Travel, Bestway, or similar retail groups.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Develop your expertise through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service. 
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12 months 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP. 
  • Access our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), which is provided by Bupa. 
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF

About Central Functions

Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.

Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG? 

THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.

This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.

You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.

We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.

What you'll do:

Strategic Direction

  • Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC
  • Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases
  • Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters — setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap
  • Evaluate where THG should use Ingen capability versus external tooling, and ensure every technology choice is documented and commercially justified
  • Drive the business towards a single source of truth — reducing data silos, resolving mastering conflicts, and building confidence in our data across the organisation

Engineering & Data Platform

  • Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition
  • Own the evolution of our GCP/BigQuery platform — from how data is ingested and stored, to how it is structured for downstream consumption
  • Set engineering standards — version control, testing, error handling, documentation — and ensure they are consistently applied
  • Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering — this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work

Data Governance

  • Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start — we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly
  • Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC
  • Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure
  • Build the culture and processes that make governance a positive enabler rather than a compliance burden

Reporting & BI

  • Own the consistency and quality of all business performance reporting across THG PLC — dashboards, KPI reports, executive-level views
  • Ensure that any regularly used report or dashboard is owned, maintained and built to a consistent standard — no more ad hoc reporting that lives outside a managed framework
  • Lead the evolution of our Tableau estate and assess when alternative or complementary tooling should be introduced

Leadership & People

  • Lead, develop and retain a high-performing team across three functions — Engineering, Governance and Reporting
  • Set clear direction and accountability for each function, developing your direct reports into leaders in their own right
  • Build a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity and continuous improvement
  • Influence and educate senior stakeholders across the business — building data literacy and trust in data assets

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

Essential

  • Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in data engineering, data platform or data leadership roles, with at least 3 years at a senior or head-of level
  • Deep hands-on experience with GCP and BigQuery — you must have built and scaled data platforms on this stack
  • Experience across multiple data domains — ideally at least two of Customer, Commercial and Operations
  • Proven track record of evolving a business's data architecture — you can point to concrete examples of how you changed the way a business ingests, stores and consumes its data
  • Strong understanding of data governance principles — data quality, metadata management, mastering and lineage
  • Experience working with or alongside a technology partner or platform team (similar to our Ingenuity relationship)
  • Demonstrated use of AI in data engineering contexts — AI-assisted pipeline development, automated quality monitoring, or similar
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills — able to influence at Director and C-suite level

Desirable

  • Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer goods
  • Familiarity with Dataform, dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks
  • Experience with data cataloguing or governance tooling (Collibra, Alation, DataHub or equivalent)
  • Exposure to ML/AI platform requirements — understanding what good data foundations look like to enable data science and personalisation

Wellbeing Support

Other Perks

In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty. Our humble expectations You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring: Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations. High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision. Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team. Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization. Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
