title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. ü Team collaboration Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. ü Self development Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar. Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation. Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding. We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email

Connect with us!

LinkedIn | Glassdoor | Indeed | FeeFo | Trustpilot | YouTube | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter | TikTok |

raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content
  • Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings
  • Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities
  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

 

#LI - HYBRID 

#LI - RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Backend Engineer, Subscriptions
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI. 💡 Why Subscriptions? An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship. Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale. Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity. A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously. 🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who: Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR. Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own? Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team. Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype. If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in. 🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability. Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them. Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do. Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception. 🙌 About You You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends. What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work. You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through. 🌍 Where You'll Work These roles are based in our tech hub in London. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Who We Are Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security to join our London (Hybrid) team. In this role, you will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for enabling proactive security outcomes with "security paved paths" to ensure a safe, reliable and resilient delivery network. Get to know our Proactive Security Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. About the Team At Deliveroo we're striving to build London's best and most admired Security Engineering organisation as part of our global team based across North America and Europe. Our London based Security Engineering team is looking for a Software Engineer to lead the design, development and operation of security services within Deliveroo's Product and Cloud Security domains. You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for building " security paved paths " to ensure a safe, reliable and resilient delivery network. This is a London based position reporting directly to the European Senior Manager of our Security Engineering team based in London. What You'll Need to Thrive Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale. Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build "paved paths" that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process. Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership. Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime. Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor. Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation. Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity. Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering. Requirements Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company's infrastructure security posture. title: Delivery Manager Genflex
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. raw.title: Delivery Manager Genflex
raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

title: Product Manager H/F
description:
Product Manager – Innovation & Design

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.

 

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.

Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.

Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.

Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.

 

Vos responsabilités 

  • Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.
  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.
  • Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.
  • Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.

Compétences et expériences désirées  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.
  • Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.
  • Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.
  • Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

 

Nos marqueurs distinctifs :

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence
    Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco”
    Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

 

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  6. Engineering (Delivery)

 

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

 

Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.

You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines. You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention. You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop. You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners. You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones. Ideally, you have Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees. Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization. Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs. Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities. Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression. Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions. Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams. Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate. Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling. Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field. Why this role matters Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions. This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work. raw.title: Engineering Team Lead, Fleet Delivery
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

raw.jobDescription:
About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

Dune's Vision

https://dune.com/blog/dune-vision

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Data Products builds and owns datasets end to end: from raw chain data through decoding to the 3000+ models and 4 petabytes we curate, share directly with customers, and replicate into their warehouses.

The role will focus on the lifecycle of building high quality data: orchestrating thousands of interdependent models, propagating schema changes without breaking downstream consumers, propagating corrections.
That is a software architecture problem in a data domain. This role is a hybrid: a backend engineer who thinks in systems and contracts, working on data.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will come back with a design, a sequence, and work the team can pick up, while building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will

  • Design and build the control plane for our curated data lifecycle: dependency-aware orchestration, backfills, restatements, retries, partial failure, and recovery

  • Decide, dataset by dataset, whether the answer is a model, a service or a job, and own that architecture through production

  • Design the contracts between ingestion and curation so a dataset can be reasoned about end to end

  • Build alerting and data quality signals that catch real problems and stay quiet otherwise, so on-call is about incidents rather than noise

  • Work across Go, Kotlin, Rust, Python and SQL, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

  • Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

You might be a great fit if

  • You are a backend engineer who has gone deep on data systems, or a data engineer who became a strong software engineer. You ship production services, not only pipelines

  • You have built or materially extended orchestration and scheduling systems, and can explain precisely what breaks at scale and why

  • You have handled schema evolution and data correctness in a system with real consumers downstream, where a breaking change has a cost

  • You have built or operated stateful stream processing in production (Flink,Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming, RisingWave, Materialize, Feldera)

  • You have strong SQL and modeling skills on large datasets, and an interest in how the query engine underneath actually executes your work

  • You have solid computer science fundamentals and distributed systems understanding

  • You debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds

  • You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus

  • Deep experience with a transformation framework such as dbt or SQLMesh: specifically, having hit its limits and built beyond them

  • Data lake formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

  • Stateful stream processing in production (Flink, Kafka Streams, Spark Structured Streaming)

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

  • A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

  • We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

  • On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise to help grow Firefox Enterprise in France. This is a high-impact enterprise sales role for someone who is excited to build deep relationships with customers and help them achieve success using Firefox Enterprise.   

What you’ll do: 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships
  • Understand our customer goals, challenges, and business needs 
  • Drive Firefox Enterprise adoption, engagement, and overall satisfaction across the account
  • Manage renewals and proactively address retention risks
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Support, Product, Solution Engineering) to deliver a seamless customer experience
  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including additional seats, upgraded tiers, or new use cases
  • Track account health, usage, and performance metrics, including forecast reports on retention, renewal and expansion
  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and success planning with customers
  • Resolve issues and escalate when necessary to ensure timely resolution

What you’ll bring: 

  • Significant experience in enterprise SaaS, infrastructure, security, or platform account management, sales, customer support or other customer facing roles
  • Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to establish trust and credibility at all levels of a customer organization
  • Proven track record of supporting customer renewals, retention, and revenue growth
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
  • Must be willing and able to travel within France as needed for the role, with a preference for candidates located in the Paris metro area
  • Must be willing and able to occasionally accommodate collaboration and meetings aligned with U.S. business hours
  • Negotiation and influence skills to support renewals, expansions, and customer advocacy
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. About the team and role

Mozilla's Web Conferencing team owns the media capture and sharing features that make Firefox work for video calls: screen, window, and tab capture, and the interface users interact with when they share content in Google Meet, Zoom, or Jitsi.

  • Implement approved UX designs for Firefox's screen, window, and tab sharing experience, and see them through to release

  • Ability to get productive quickly in a large, mature codebase you didn't write
  • Experience writing automated tests for user interfaces
  • Strong asynchronous written communication, since the team is distributed across timezones
  • Comfort working in public, since Bugzilla and Phabricator are open

  • Prior contributions to Firefox or another open-source browser
  • Familiarity with Firefox front-end architecture: browser/, custom elements, XUL, Fluent localization
  • Experience with WebRTC or getDisplayMedia
  • Accessibility experience with modal dialogs and list navigation
  • Experience with Mozilla's test frameworks (browser-chrome, mochitest)

  • Open source environment experience

Our Order and Inventory Management Team is looking for a Support Engineer (f/m/d) - Domain Manager on a Permanent Contract based in Lille.

Passionate about logistics innovation, our team of 10 designs and operates the global digital solutions orchestrating Decathlon's order and stock flows. Our impact: guaranteeing the right product in the right place at the right time for our stores, warehouses, and marketplaces worldwide. Our challenges: accelerating the group's digital transformation, integrating new business models (circular economy, wholesale), and preparing the transition to SAP S/4HANA.

YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

As a Support Engineer (f/m/d), you will ensure the stability, efficiency, and evolution of our order and stock orchestration tools. Your core responsibilities include:

  • Run Management & User Commitments: Organize daily ticket resolution, ensure service level agreements (stock accuracy KPIs, dispatch timing), and provide dedicated support during peak commercial periods.

  • Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Perform root cause analysis, enhance monitoring tools (dashboards, control towers), and automate recurring tasks leveraging tech and AI.

  • Transformation Projects & SAP: Challenge upcoming product features with the project team, drive updates on our SAP ECC module (SD/MM), and help prepare the S/4HANA migration planned for 2028.

  • Communication & On-Call Rotations: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders during incidents or maintenance, and participate in on-call rotations for critical operations.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Education & Background: Engineering degree (preferably in Computer Science) or equivalent experience.

  • Functional & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of supply chain processes combined with proven experience on SAP modules (SD and MM).

  • Automation Mindset: Passion for eliminating manual repetitive tasks, tracking data performance, and integrating AI into daily operations.

  • Soft Skills: Team player spirit ("Play Collective"), clear communication, strong prioritization skills, and collaborative leadership.

  • Languages: Fluent English is mandatory (daily international scope).

TECH STACK

  • ERP / Systems: SAP ECC (SD & MM modules), S/4HANA roadmap.

  • Monitoring & Data: Operational control towers, ticketing systems, and custom monitoring dashboards.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Hybrid work organization (up to 2 days of remote work per week);

  • Equipment provided in line with your role and our sustainability commitments (Mac, Windows, or Chromebook);

  • A local project team within a global network (international career opportunities);

  • Continuous learning and development (technical certifications in year one, internal/external training programs);

  • Comprehensive compensation package (employee stock ownership scheme, monthly/quarterly bonuses).

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION AND ACCESSIBILITY

At Decathlon, we recognize the immense value that diversity brings to our teams, and we continuously strive to foster and cultivate an inclusive and equitable workplace: this is why Inclusion is one of our Human Fundamentals. We encourage people of all backgrounds and abilities to apply, as we firmly believe that diversity of thought, culture, identity, and lived experience makes us stronger.

Decathlon is also committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the process, you can request them via the application form; your request will remain confidential and will not affect the outcome of your hiring process.

 

DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT 

What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.


Changing the game for good. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.
